brand_headline: Run every restaurant menu from one place
brand_subline: Onboard restaurants, manage subscriptions and publish AI-generated 3D dishes to guests.
name: Name
currency_code_rule: Use a 3-letter ISO code, e.g. USD
slug_rule: Slug may only contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.
slug_reserved: This slug is reserved and cannot be used.
slug_preview: The restaurant menu will live at https://{slug}.<menu-domain>
slug_change_warning: Changing the slug changes the menu URL: printed QR codes stop working.
deactivate_hint: Deactivating stops the tenant's admins, public menu and API keys. Prefer it over deleting.
owner_must_change_password: The owner must change this password at first login.
country_sets_time_zone: The country sets the restaurant time zone
exactly_one_owner: Choose exactly one owner: a tenant or an API key.
credit_owner_hint: Choose a tenant or an API key, not both
pack_edit_note: Editing a pack never changes purchases already recorded
empty_price_hint: Leave empty to use the list price
price_currency_together: Price and currency must both be set, or both left empty (free trial).
discount_together: Discount and discount type must both be set, or both left empty.
percentage_0_100: A percentage discount must be between 0 and 100.
from_after_to: From date must not be after the to date.
exactly_one_subscriber: Choose exactly one subscriber: a tenant or an API key.
upgrade_from_hint: Empty = now. The current subscription ends and a new one starts.
rotate_hint: The old key keeps working for this long (1-168 hours), then stops.
rotated_expiry_shorten_only: The expiry of a rotated key can only be shortened.
secret_shown_once: You will not be able to see this key again. Copy it now and store it safely.
ip_hint: One per line, up to 50. Each an IP or CIDR (203.0.113.0/24). Empty = any IP.
ip_error_format: not a valid IP or CIDR
ip_error_prefix: the prefix length is not allowed (/0 is rejected)
ip_error_host_bits: host bits are set (use the network address)
force_regenerate_desc: Bypasses only the 'not changed enough to regenerate' lock for a customer item. Quota and the one-active-job rule still apply.
per_tenant_not_above_global: Per-tenant limit cannot exceed the global limit.
raise_global_limit_warning: Only raise the global limit if the provider plan allows it.
broadcast_desc: Send an announcement to restaurant admins (inbox and realtime) and their API keys (inbox and webhook). Plain text only.
remove_own_permissions_warning: You are removing permissions from your own account. Click confirm to continue.
password_reset_done: Temporary password set. The user must change it at next login.
reset_effect_hint: The user's sessions end and they must change this password at next login. It is never shown again.
user_must_change_password: The user must change this password at first login.
revenue_per_currency_note: Revenue is shown per currency; different currencies are never added together.
feature_api_keys: Partner API keys, logs and reports
stage_headline:
Your restaurant,
as your guests see it.
gaze_idle: Every dish on your menu deserves to be seen.
gaze_error: Those details didn't match. Check them and try again.
signin_desc: Sign in to manage your menu, dishes and tables.
page_update_body: A newer version is available. Reload to continue where you left off.
error_occurred_desc: An unexpected error occurred. Try again, or go back to the dashboard.
models_waiting: 3D models are waiting for your review
delete_irreversible: It will be removed permanently. This cannot be undone.
preview_body: The message appears here as the recipient will see it.
recipients_admins_desc: In the inbox and live while the console is open.
recipients_keys_desc: In the inbox and by webhook when one is set.
report_desc_tenant_content: What each tenant has built: restaurants, menu items and the state of their 3D models.
report_desc_api_key_content: The content behind each partner key, its validity and when it was last used.
report_desc_registrations: Every subscription with its price, discount and period, for tenants and API keys.
report_desc_tenant_revenue: Revenue per tenant split by currency; different currencies are never added together.
report_desc_generation_usage: Daily and monthly generation use against the limits, extra credits and API key pools.
activate_theme_hint: The theme goes live on your menu and replaces the active one of the same mode (light or dark).
bulk_all_done_hint: New dishes without a model will appear here.
bulk_cap_reached: Your quota allows {{n}} more generations right now
bulk_desc: Choose the dishes that have no 3D model and generate them together (up to 500). The list is capped at what your quota allows.
categories_desc: Group the menu into categories and sub-categories, in the order guests will see them.
category_has_content: This category still has sub-categories or items. Move or delete them first, or deactivate the category instead.
force_new_hint: Skip the shared 3D library and always generate a fresh model
general_qr_desc: Opens the whole menu. Print it for the entrance or the counter.
generate_blocked: The model could not be started: it is already queued, unchanged since its last model, or the quota is used up.
inactive_hidden_hint: Inactive items are hidden from the public menu.
ingredients_regen_hint: Adding or removing an ingredient lets you regenerate the 3D model.
library_reused: Reused from the library: instant and free
no_categories_hint: Start with a category such as Starters or Main dishes.
no_ingredients_hint: Add ingredients so guests know what is inside, and which ones they can leave out.
no_model_hint: Generate one from the dish photo, or upload your own GLB file.
no_photos_hint: Upload a photo or let AI generate one. The first photo is the card image.
no_social_hint: Add the places guests can find you online.
no_subscription: There is no active subscription, so generation uses default limits. Contact Shoof to renew.
no_tables_hint: Add your tables, then generate a QR code for each one.
no_themes_hint: Create a light and a dark theme, then activate them.
owner_role_warning: The Owner role holds every permission. Changing or deleting it can lock people out.
parent_category_hint: Leave empty for a top-level category. Only top-level categories can be parents.
photos_limit: A dish can have at most 5 photos (including ones being generated).
profile_desc: How your restaurant appears on the menu and in reports.
qr_note: QR codes cannot be edited or deleted. Generating again returns the same code.
regen_locked_hint: Regeneration unlocks when the name or description changes a lot, or an ingredient is added or removed.
roles_desc: A role is a set of permissions you give to team members.
save_first: Save the theme first, then upload images.
social_desc: One link per platform. To change a platform, delete it and add it again.
tables_desc: Each table gets its own QR code, so guests open your menu from their table.
themes_desc: Control how your public menu looks. One light and one dark theme can be active at a time.
skip_nochange: Already has a model and has not changed enough
discard_changes_desc: The edits you made to this role will be lost.
access_denied_body: This account is signed in, but none of its roles allows these actions.
access_hint_role: Give the role its permissions in
access_hint_key: If you are the Owner and everything is refused, the app key (VITE_APP_API_KEY) or the restaurant code is probably wrong.
access_SubscriptionExpired: This restaurant has no active subscription
access_IpNotAllowed: Your IP address is not allowed for this app key
ready_title_done: Your whole menu is ready in 3D
attention_clear: Nothing is waiting for you right now.
att_quota: Share of this month's credits used (%)
sufra_desc: Each plate is a category. The ring fills as its dishes get 3D models; the inner ring shows photos.
sufra_empty: No categories yet. Add your first category to set the table.
sufra_aria: {{name}}: {{items}} dishes, {{models}} with a 3D model, {{photos}} with a photo
souk_bins_hint: Photo height in each bin = share of its dishes ready in 3D
souk_shelf_title: On the shelf: your dishes, photographed

preview_empty: No dishes are visible to guests yet.
preview_live_hint: The address the general QR code opens.
preview_qr_hint: Print it for the tables or the window, or create one per table on the Tables page.
preview_theme_off: No active theme for this mode; the default colours show
preview_qr_ready: The general QR code is ready
preview_qr_missing: The general QR code isn't created yet
preview_tap_hint: Tap a dish on the phone to see its photos, ingredients and 3D model.
copy_failed: Couldn't copy; select the link and copy it
empty_plate_hint: Nothing here yet. What you add will show in this list.
session_expired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
contact_email_hint: Gets the subscription-expiry reminders (30, 7 and 1 days before the end). Empty: they go to the Owner admins.
contact_email_invalid: The contact email address is not valid.
phone_too_long: The contact phone number is too long (50 characters at most).
owner_role_locked: This is the Owner role: its name and description can't change, it can't be deleted, and it can only gain permissions, never lose them.
owner_permission_locked: The Owner role can't lose this permission
add_model_by_url: Or add a model by URL
upload_model_hint: GLB is required (web viewer); USDZ is optional (iPhone AR); each file 5 MB at most.
tenant_disabled_body: The restaurant's account isn't active right now, often because its subscription ended. Contact Shoof to renew it or switch it back on.
user_disabled_body: An administrator has deactivated your user. Ask them, or Shoof, to switch it back on.
primary_admin_locked: The restaurant's primary admin stays active and keeps the Owner role.
primary_keeps_owner: The primary admin must keep the Owner role.
roles_you_can_grant: You can give only roles whose permissions you all have; only an Owner can give the Owner role.
delete_role_revokes: Everyone with this role loses its permissions within 30 seconds. This can't be undone; a new role with the same name starts with no members.
cannot_grant_permission: You can only grant permissions you have yourself
access_no_roles: Your sign-in carries no role, so the server refuses every page. The account was created without being linked to the Owner role: the backend must link it (login returns roles from its Release 1).
plan_period: How much of the plan period has passed
preview_ar_fallback: No Arabic name yet: guests see the English one.
access_InvalidApiKey: The dashboard's app key (VITE_APP_API_KEY) is missing or wrong for this server.
